name: Viscera Devourer
tactics: This creature trades standard actions and move actions for minor actions, using hungry viscera up to three times in a round. If it has only one opponent in reach, it tries to wrap all four of its viscera tendrils around the one target. If it has multiple targets, it tries to grab as many of them as possible. When the creature is bloodied, it uses devour viscera to regain hit points.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Visceral Ward
traits.details: The viscera devourer gains a +2 bonus to all defenses while it is grabbing one or more creatures.

hit.description: the creature wraps a viscera tendril around the target; 1d4 + 5 damage, and the target is grabbed (until escape). A viscera devourer has four tendrils and can grab up to four creatures at once, or multiple tendrils can grab a single target (the target takes a -2 penalty to escape checks per additional tendril grabbing it)

effect.description: The viscera devourer draws life energy from every living target it is grabbing. A grabbed target takes 5 necrotic damage per viscera tendril grabbing it, and the viscera devourer regains the same amount of hit points.
